title: 16th October - Navratri Celebrations
summary: What a lovely evening we had at our Navratri celebrations at Orient Club, jointly celebrated by our Club and RC of Mumbai Downtown Sealand, with more than 50 of us coming together to celebrate!
description:
What a lovely evening we had at our Navratri celebrations at Orient Club, jointly celebrated by our Club and RC of Mumbai Downtown Sealand, with more than 50 of us coming together to celebrate! The hall looked beautiful with its festive decorations, flowers and rangoli — courtesy Rotarian Kishore Chokhani. The evening had everything that makes a celebration special — cake cutting for our members celebrating their special days, and beautiful mehndi designs created on the hands of ladies who wished to adorn them for the occasion.
The singer soon got everyone onto the dance floor, and there was no stopping us! Congrats to Rtn Nayan and R/Ann Anisha for the best dancing couple and individual dancing to Rtns Reshma, Bhushan and Sonal which truly added to the excitement. With excellent food, wonderful music and great company, we danced, laughed and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.
It was an evening full of festive cheer, fun and fellowship. Attended by 19 members and 5 Partners taking total 24
